newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent firm on technicals, stronger physicals.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent firm on technicals, stronger physicals.

text.p: LONDON, Jan 22 (Reuter) IPE Brent futures were steady at the higher levels achieved on an earlier technical correction at midday on Wednesday.
March Brent was trading 35 cents at $22.71 a barrel, while February gas oil was $3.25 higher at $207.00 a tonne.
Traders attributed Brent's opening gains firmer to gas oil at the open.
"Gas oil was getting a bit low, it was due for a correction and this helped pull back up Brent," said one trader.
Talk of short-term strength on the physical Brent market was also seen helping the complex.

A cargo of physical Brent which had been offered earlier at Feb Brent +2 cents -- more than 10 cents above the previous reported deal -- was heard to have traded and traders close to the market felt a level near the offer may have been achieved.
Traders said the market would be monitoring American Petroleum Institute (API) data due out later on Wednesday.

Many traders said they expected the data to show falls in distillate stocks due to the recent cold weather in the United States, but that any bullish impact would be muted by further decreases in the deficit against last year's stock levels.
